notes.title: Demo Update! New Level up System and many many quality of life improvments
notes.notes: [p]These last few months have been working to improve the demo with much user feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Implemented a new level up system.[/p][p]As your cards battle the on coming hoards they'll gain xp. Then in the new camp scene you'll be able to spend gold training cards WITH OTHER CARDS! [/p][p][/p][p]So we add another level of value to cards as some will be able to train your other cards level up with more attack or defence than other cards. But what's more is abilities can be shared! This means that your archer's arrows can now become fire arrows. You're blood priest can gain power as it moves, your tank makes other cards cheaper! And many more - hopefully this will add alot more strategies and personality to your Manipulus and to your choices.[/p][p][/p][p]Many bug fixes -[/p][p]Save game improvements -[/p][p]Ui improvements  ++++[/p][p][/p][p]Hope to hear any feedback![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update v.0.3
notes.notes:
I've added unique class abilities for your cards! 🎖️
Each hero class now brings its own passive traits or tactical perks to battle — like armor recovery, ranged bonuses and there will be many more creating new ways to play


Let us know what combos you discover — and which class you’re rallying behind.

notes.title: Demo Update v0.2 – Faster, Clearer, More Fun!
notes.notes:
✨ What’s New in v0.2:

⚔️ Faster Battles
Combat now moves quicker and feels more responsive.

Animations and transitions have been streamlined for a better flow.

🧹 Cutscene Cleanup
Removed or trimmed unnecessary cutscenes to keep the pacing tight.

Focus is now more on playing, not waiting.

📘 Tutorial Overhaul
The tutorial is now much shorter and easier to digest.

You’ll get into the action faster, with less text and more clarity.

🧠 Improved Battle UI
Revamped UI for battles makes everything clearer: enemy intents, energy, and status effects are easier to read at a glance.

Better visuals, better decisions, better gameplay.

This is just the beginning. I’m continuing to gather feedback and shape the game toward launch. If you tried an earlier version, I’d love for you to hop back in and see what’s changed.

🎮 Give it another shot: and let me know what you think!

📬 Got feedback or suggestions? Drop them in the discussions or ping me on reddit.

Thank you for playing — your support means the world.

 Chazzy | Chazzy Games
